description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the Thunder project, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status checking, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container instances, providing methods to retrieve and insert containers, and handle logging.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, providing lifecycle management such as start, stop, status, and configuration handling.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CRunContainerAdministrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor for the container administrator class.

methods.name: ~CRunContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Destructor for the container administrator class.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging for containers, currently a placeholder for container-scope logging.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializes container context and logging; destructor handles cleanup.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (currently null).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers from previous runs.
